steps.npc: Oh, that's nice. I used to wander around, back when my legs were better. So long ago.
That's the trouble with young people these days. Not my boy, though. He's a good boy, always working. That's why he never visits. Run along now, young [man/lady/one].

talking-to-old-man-yarlo-after-the-quest.npc: Hello again, young [man/lady/one]. You really did wonders for my little home. I feel so much happier living here now.

options.text: That's good to hear. Goodbye now.

steps.player: That's good to hear. Goodbye now.

options.text: Tell me about more things I can do with Construction.

steps.player: Tell me about more things I can do with Construction.
